subject: Observability activation & SRE readiness — telemetry launch play
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@cloudedtech.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops-team@cloudedtech.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability activation & SRE readiness

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited to move from evaluation to an operational rollout. We want to align on a concrete plan for the telemetry/observability work that will let our SREs run the service at scale. High level asks: dashboards for key flows, tracing hooks for request correlation, an error taxonomy so we can prioritize alerts, alert routing (pager/on-call → slack → email), and a runbook skeleton for common incidents.

Attached is our current dashboard screenshot (current-dashboard-rc1.png) and a short inventory of the services we'll be onboarding (backend, inference-proxy, routing-layer). Can Redwood own the initial runbook template and a proposed alert matrix, and can we aim for an internal pilot with the backend and inference-proxy in 3 weeks?

Availability for a kickoff this week: Wed 7/16 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu 7/17 14:00–15:00 PT.

Thanks,
Sarah Li
Head of Site Reliability
CloudedTech

--
Attachment: current-dashboard-rc1.png (image/png)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@cloudedtech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 12:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability activation & SRE readiness

Sarah — thanks, this is clear and good timing. We can own the kickoff deliverables: an onboarding checklist, a runbook template, and a proposed alert matrix. Proposed plan (high level):

- Week 0 (kickoff): align scope (services, SLI/SLO targets, retention) + share Drive folder
- Week 1: implement tracing hooks for request id/span propagation on backend + test traces in staging
- Week 2: implement dashboard primitives + baseline alert thresholds (non-paging)
- Week 3: pilot runbook + paging alerts for inference-proxy + retro

I've attached a short kickoff agenda (redwood-kickoff-agenda.pdf). Can you confirm stakeholders (primary SRE, product owner, and security reviewer) and whether we should include procurement/contracting in the same thread?

Kickoff times: Wed 7/16 10:00 PT works for us — confirm and we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looping in Marissa/Neha/Ben/Karthik to drive the technical pieces.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Customer Success (Observability)
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood-kickoff-agenda.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah.li@cloudedtech.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability activation & SRE readiness

Adding technical notes ahead of the kickoff so the SREs can prep:

- Tracing hooks: we need a stable request-id header (X-Request-ID) and Otel span attributes for model_id, route, user_tier. We'll propose span tag conventions in the kickoff doc.
- Dashboards: baseline panels — 95p latency (inference), token/sec, response-fail-rate, cross-region queue length, KV cache hit rate. Suggest 7d/30d windows and a 90-day aggregated view for trend analysis.
- Error taxonomy: three buckets (client / transient infra / model-degradation). Each error class maps to an initial severity (info / page / critical) and suggested responders.
- Alert routing: paging only for critical infra (loss of KV cache, >10% 5m fail-rate), slack for ops-team for transient infra, email for product stakeholders.
- Runbooks: we'll push a runbook-template.md to the Drive and provide first-pass pages for inference-proxy and backend. Include links to the escalation matrix and playbook steps.

Attachments: proposed-alert-matrix.csv, runbook-template.md
Related: Drive folder (https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/observability-cloudedtech-kickoff), JIRA SUP-4321 (for onboarding tasks).

On procurement — Sarah, if procurement needs to be on the call we can add a 10-minute slot to review license/contract milestones; otherwise we can handle contracting offline with your procurement contact.

-Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

--

Attachment: runbook-template.md (text/markdown)

Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability activation & SRE readiness

Thanks everyone — Wed 7/16 10:00 PT worked well; appreciated the walkthrough. Quick notes / agreed actions from the pilot sync: 

- Redwood to submit first-pass alert matrix and runbook pages for inference-proxy by EOD Tue 7/22 (Ben/Marissa owners)
- CloudedTech SRE to add environment variables for X-Request-ID in staging by 7/21 (ops-team owner)
- Security will send a short questionnaire; Redwood to include a list of telemetry retention windows and encryption-at-rest notes by 7/24 (Neha owner)
- We agreed on initial SLO: 95p latency < 200ms for non-batched inference and error rate < 1% for baseline traffic.

I attached our procurement kickoff notes (cloudedtech-security-reqs.pdf) for visibility. Let's keep the drive folder as the single source of truth and use JIRA SUP-4321 for task tracking.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — putting Redwood on our vendor onboarding queue.

Best,
Sarah
Head of Site Reliability, CloudedTech
